name: file-audio
useCase: Identify an audio file in a file picker or attachment list.
misuse: Do not use this file symbol for a playback control or microphone input.

16.reason: A single open notehead and curved flag fit below the page fold, with a 1px gap above the page bottom.

24.reason: A separately drawn single note has a larger open head and a longer flag, with at least 1.5px of space from the page outline.
